info.title: Wildlife conservation — implemented APIs
info.description: 44 implemented APIs. Added in 1.3.0: public registration park catalog, community response workflow, researcher analytics/report access, and community conflict statistics. Park and route creation are now documented. Added in 1.2.0: community registration, manager-created staff accounts, and password changes. JSON uses the response-generator envelope. Image/PDF downloads return binary content. Temporary-password accounts can access only profile and password change among protected APIs. Password changes invalidate previously issued tokens. See implemented-api.md for flows and setup. Responses include X-Request-ID and X-Trace-ID for log correlation. An optional X-Request-ID uses 1-64 letters, digits or hyphens; an optional X-B3-TraceId (preferred) or X-Trace-ID uses a nonzero 16- or 32-digit hexadecimal trace ID. Invalid or absent IDs are generated.

post.description: Public login. Validate the active account and BCrypt password; generic 401 for invalid credentials. login.data.user.passwordChangeRequired tells Flutter to show password change for temporary staff credentials. The token string in this example is a placeholder.

post.description: NEW in 1.2.0. A PARK_MANAGER with a completed password change can create RANGER, LIAISON_OFFICER or RESEARCHER accounts. All 1-20 requested parkIds must exist and belong to the manager. Creates an active account with passwordChangeRequired=true. The password is hashed and never returned; share the initial password with the staff member separately. Unsupported roles return 400, outside-scope parks return 403 and nonexistent assigned parks return 404. Duplicate normalized emails return 409. Staff login -> profile/password change -> login again before operational APIs are available. Public manager creation is unavailable.

put.description: Immutable completed snapshot; active recording remains local. Validate assignment ownership, one patrol per assignment, ordered timestamps and location/array limits. Compute distance from continuous GPS segments, ignoring gaps over 120 seconds and fixes with reported accuracy worse than 100 meters; manual waypoints do not add travel distance. Identical replay is safe; changed replay or reused assignment is 409. End may be at most five minutes in the future. Equal-time GPS segments add no distance. Temporary-password accounts receive 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

Category must match role: ranger INCIDENT/ALERT_RESPONSE; liaison ALERT_RESPONSE; community member COMMUNITY_REPORT; researcher/manager CAMERA_TRAP. Same UUID, owner, category, park and bytes returns 200; changed bytes/metadata is 409. Only owner can access unlinked uploads. Decoded images are limited to 20 million pixels. NEW alerts only, before acceptance. Leave alert NEW and record one decline per officer. Same reason retry returns 200; changed repeated decline or invalid state is 409. Automatic reassignment/escalation is deferred. Declines are limited to 100 distinct officers per alert. Temporary-password accounts receive 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

get.description: Inclusive park-local dates, at most 92 days. Aggregate stored incidents, completed patrols, community reports and resolved alerts. Potential hotspot threshold: 3 incidents per area. Route coverage denominator is unique routes with assignments scheduled to start in the period; numerator is those routes with an assignment patrol completed in the period. This is not geographic area coverage. No assignments => coveragePercent=null. No data => dataAvailable=false, 200; database failure =>503. Temporary-password accounts receive 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED. Managers and researchers can access analytics and saved reports within their assigned parks. Conflict statistics now include community report types, area counts and daily trends.

post.description: NEW in 1.2.0. Public registration fixes the role to COMMUNITY_MEMBER and creates an active account with passwordChangeRequired=false. parkId must exist and be in COMMUNITY_REGISTRATION_PARK_IDS (default park-yala; empty disables public registration). Names are trimmed and emails are lowercased. Unknown/server-owned fields such as role, active, id, parkIds or tokenVersion are rejected. Duplicate normalized emails return 409. No JWT is issued; call /auth/login next. Email ownership verification is outside this milestone.

201.description: Created account; log in separately. No Location header.

post.description: NEW in 1.2.0. Available to every active authenticated account, including those with temporary passwords. Verify currentPassword against the authenticated subject; newPassword must differ. New passwords require 6-72 Unicode code points and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. The atomic write clears passwordChangeRequired and increments the internal tokenVersion. ALL previously issued JWTs, including the current token, are invalid after success. Discard tokens and log in again. No userId is accepted and no new token is returned. Concurrent or repeated requests cannot overwrite a completed password change.

200.description: Password changed; discard all stored tokens and log in again.

post.description: Atomically claim a SUBMITTED report in an assigned park. Sets RESPONDING, assignedOfficerId and acceptedAt. An identical retry by the same officer returns 200. Another officer or a resolved report returns 409 COMMUNITY_REPORT_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.
